newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran cuts May crude price formula to Asia - traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran cuts May crude price formula to Asia - traders.

text.p: State-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) has cut its May crude pricing formula for Iranian Light crude and Iranian Heavy crude both by 10 cents per barrel from April, traders in Tokyo said on Monday.
This means that Iranian Light for May loading will be priced at Oman's MPM minus 17 cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor added to that.
The formula for Iranian Heavy will be Dubai quotations minus 23 cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor then subtracted.
The price of Iranian Light crude is linked to Saudi Arabia's Arab Light crude, while Iranian Heavy crude moves in tandem with Arab Medium crude.
Iranian crude prices are set on a quarterly basis.
However, under a contract agreement, NIOC and its customers can review prices whenever Saudi Arabian crude prices move substantially.
